judgementCalls: 'Certified MCS+ Automated Blood Collection Tech' (a bullet under the 2001-2005 donor-collection job) is required as a credential, with no status.
No phlebotomy certification is stated, only the job titles; a phlebotomist certification entry is not allowed.
'Trained in HIPPA compliance' and 'CLIA & OSHA compliance' are not credentials.
The MBA is dated 'Current', which is keyed as not completed.
No bachelor's degree is listed, so one implied by the MBA is not allowed.
